versions.changelog: Add browser OAuth login, renewable private credentials, and logout/revocation. New users complete full channel onboarding before approving the skill connection; login waits up to one hour and resumes the original request. Add companion remote MCP setup instructions for scoped scripts, AI conversations, metadata, thumbnails, history, and scheduling. Existing API-key access remains available. Requires the Teleskopiq 1.13.0 backend/frontend release.

Add script search and editing, comments, history restoration, resumable AI questions, thumbnail references and selection. Fix SSE completion handling, stale generation results, API-key parsing, and publishing-day scheduling. CLI output is now JSON with explicit error and question exit codes. Add private credential-file loading, portable setup, and regression tests. Compatibility: API-key style reads and partial thumbnail updates require the accompanying Teleskopiq server fixes; older deployments may still reject style reads or replace thumbnail maps.
Fix: ai-write now uses SSE (Server-Sent Events) instead of WebSocket — matches Teleskopiq's actual subscription transport. Fix: correct GraphQL field name (script not scriptId).
Fix metadata: add homepage (teleskopiq.com), sync version to 1.1.0, add websocket-client dependency, clarify TELESKOPIQ_API_KEY is required
Add get-style command, ai-write command with WebSocket streaming, --ai-write flag on full-flow. Always fetch style profile before writing scripts.
Fix: default endpoint in teleskopiq.py updated to https://teleskopiq.com/api/graphql — all three files (skill.json, SKILL.md, scripts/teleskopiq.py) now consistent
Fix: correct default endpoint to https://teleskopiq.com/api/graphql
Fix: TELESKOPIQ_API_KEY marked required, default endpoint updated to https://app.teleskopiq.com/api/graphql
Add skill.json manifest with env vars, categories, and requirements metadata
Initial release — GraphQL API skill for Teleskopiq (YouTube script, metadata, thumbnail, and auto-scheduling)
